metadata.description: Create a media played event in the HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Create a media played event in the HubSpot account. This endpoint is used to log when media content has been played, which can be useful for tracking user engagement with media resources.

_hsenc.label: Hsenc
_hsenc.description: An encoding parameter used internally by HubSpot.

contactId.label: Contact Id
contactId.description: The unique identifier for the contact associated with the media play event.

contactUtk.label: Contact Utk
contactUtk.description: The unique tracking key for the contact, used for tracking purposes.

externalId.label: External Id
externalId.description: An external identifier for the media, used to correlate with external systems.

externalPlayContext.label: External Play Context
externalPlayContext.description: Additional context about the media play event, provided by external systems.

iframeUrl.label: Iframe Url
iframeUrl.description: The URL of the iframe containing the media, if applicable.

mediaBridgeId.label: Media Bridge Id
mediaBridgeId.description: A unique identifier for the media bridge instance.

mediaName.label: Media Name
mediaName.description: The name of the media that was played.

mediaType.label: Media Type
mediaType.description: The type of media that was played, such as 'VIDEO', 'AUDIO', 'DOCUMENT', 'OTHER', or 'IMAGE'.

mediaUrl.label: Media Url
mediaUrl.description: The URL of the media that was played.

occurredTimestamp.label: Occurred Timestamp
occurredTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the media play event occurred, in Unix time format.

pageId.label: Page Id
pageId.description: A unique identifier for the page where the media was played.

pageName.label: Page Name
pageName.description: The name of the page where the media was played.

pageUrl.label: Page Url
pageUrl.description: The URL of the page where the media was played.

sessionId.label: Session Id
sessionId.description: A unique identifier for the session during which the media was played.

state.label: State
state.description: The state of the media play event, indicating the current status.
